DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 閉園まであと二十分です。お帰りの道はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Dalawampung minuto na lang bago magsara ang parke. Alam ninyo ang daang palabas?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あと千歩で目標なので、もう一周したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 閉園前でも一周したい希望を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Isang libong hakbang pa ang kulang sa target ko, kaya gusto ko pang isang ikot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing gusto pang umikot kahit malapit nang magsara. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一周すると出口まで戻る時間が足りないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kapag umikot pa, baka kulangin ang oras pabalik sa labasan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 閉園時刻に歩くのをやめるだけでは遅いんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 閉園までに退園が必要だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kaya kung titigil lang sa paglalakad sa oras ng pagsasara, huli na pala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyaking kailangang makalabas bago magsara. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。その時刻までに退園をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Oo. Makalabas na kayo sa parke sa oras na iyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では出口へ向かいます。途中のベンチで靴ひもを結び直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰路の途中で靴を直せる所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pupunta na ako sa labasan. Maaari kong itali muli ang sintas sa bangko sa daan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang puwedeng ayusan ng sapatos sa daang palabas. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この先にあります。休憩の時間も含めてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Mayroon sa unahan. Isama ang oras ng pahinga sa paglalakad ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこで短く止まります。歩数を増やすために遠回りはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩時間を考慮して遠回りをやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Saglit lang akong hihinto roon. Hindi ako iikot nang malayo para dagdagan ang hakbang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Isaalang-alang ang pahinga at huwag nang lumiko nang malayo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口はベンチの先を右です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pakanan lampas sa bangko ang labasan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は目標に届かなくても終わりにします。出口へ向かいながら友人に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 歩数目標より退園を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Tatapusin ko ngayon kahit hindi maabot ang target. Kokontakin ko ang kaibigan habang papunta sa labasan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Unahin ang paglabas kaysa target ng hakbang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。時間に余裕を持ってお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11228-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Salamat. Umuwi nang may sapat pang oras.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 画面が最初に戻りましたね。お手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Bumalik sa simula ang screen. Maaari akong tumulong?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。行先を選んでいる途中でした。切符は買えたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 画面が戻った後の購入成立を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pakisuyo. Namimili pa ako ng destinasyon. Nabuo ba ang pagbili ng tiket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung natuloy ang pagbili matapos bumalik ang screen. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お金やカードは入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Naglagay na ba ng pera o card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。条件を読んでいたら画面が消えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未入金の操作経過を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa. Nawala ang screen habang binabasa ko ang kondisyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang ginawa nang wala pang bayad. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入金前なら購入は完了していません。最初から選び直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kung wala pang bayad, hindi pa tapos ang pagbili. Piliin muli mula sa simula.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 急いで押すと間違えそうです。先に買う内容を紙で整理してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入条件を先に整理したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Baka magkamali kung magmamadaling pumindot. Maaari ko munang ayusin sa papel ang bibilhin?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hilinging ayusin muna ang kundisyon ng pagbili. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。行先と利用日を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Sabihin ang destinasyon at araw ng paggamit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日、友人の所へ片道で行きます。今日使う券を買いたいのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌日片道利用だと具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Bukas, one-way papunta sa kaibigan ko. Hindi tiket na gagamitin ngayon ang gusto ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tukuying one-way bukas ang gamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 明日利用できる券か、購入方法も含め確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Titiyakin ko kung tiket na magagamit bukas, kasama ang paraan ng pagbili.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。条件が分かってから操作し、最後の確認画面を読んで払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最終確認後に支払う手順を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Ooperahin ko kapag malinaw na ang kondisyon, babasahin ang huling confirmation screen, saka magbabayad.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang magbayad matapos ang huling pagtiyak. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順でご案内します。まず利用日の選び方をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Gagabayan ko sa ayos na iyon. Una, pagpili ng araw ng paggamit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知への回答状況についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol sa estado ng sagot sa abiso, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ネットで書きましたが、また通知が来ました。二重に答えることになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: オンライン回答後の再通知を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Sinulatan ko online pero may abiso ulit. Madodoble ba ang pagsagot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Kumonsulta tungkol sa panibagong abiso matapos sumagot online. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前の画面に完了の表示はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: May lumabas bang tapos na sa dating screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「下書き保存」と出ました。そこで終わったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 下書き保存で終了したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: 'Save draft' ang nakalagay. Akala ko tapos na roon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na tumigil matapos mag-save ng draft. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保存と送信は別です。回答を受け付けた記録を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Magkaiba ang save at submit. Titingnan ko ang rekord ng pagtanggap ng sagot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この通知の番号を見てください。未送信なら、保存した内容を見直して送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知番号で受付記録の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tingnan ang numero ng abisong ito. Kung hindi pa naipasa, maaari bang repasuhin ang naka-save at ipadala?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hilinging tingnan ang pagtanggap gamit ang numero ng abiso. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その操作は案内ページで確認できます。ここで記録も照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Makikita ang hakbang sa instruction page. Itugma rin natin ang rekord dito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。新しく全部入力せず、前の下書きが残っているか先に見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残る下書きを先に探すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakisuyo. Titingnan ko muna kung naroon pa ang lumang draft kaysa ipasok lahat muli.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang hanapin muna ang natitirang draft. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録では回答は未受付です。送信後の完了表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa rekord, wala pang natatanggap na sagot. Tiyakin ang completion display matapos isumite.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 未受付と分かりました。下書きから回答を送り、完了画面を控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未受付を理解し送信完了を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naintindihan kong hindi pa natanggap. Ipapasa mula sa draft at itatala ang completion screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Unawaing hindi pa natanggap at tiyaking tapos ang pagpapasa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。送信できない場合は、この窓口へ番号と画面の内容をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Oo. Kung hindi maipasa, sabihin sa counter na ito ang numero at laman ng screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですね。受付で配慮が必要なことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Unang konsultasyon, tama? May kailangang pag-aangkop sa reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し耳が聞こえにくいです。放送で名前を呼ばれても気付かないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 放送を聞き逃す可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Medyo mahina ang pandinig ko. Baka hindi mapansin ang pagtawag ng pangalan sa speaker.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na maaaring hindi marinig ang anunsiyo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 近くでお声がけする方法を担当へ伝えましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sabihin ko ba sa kawani na tawagin kayo nang malapitan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。正面からゆっくり話してもらえると聞き取りやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正面からゆっくり話す配慮を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pakisuyo. Mas madaling marinig kung nasa harap at mabagal magsalita.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hilinging magsalita nang mabagal mula sa harap. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの辺りにお座りになりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受付から見える、この席に座ります。呼ばれたか分からない時は確認していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 着席場所と確認の可否を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sa upuang ito na kita mula sa reception. Maaari akong magtanong kung hindi tiyak na natawag na?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang upuan at itanong kung maaaring magtiyak. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。受付番号も手元に置いておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Hawakan din ang reception number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号を見せて確認します。大きな声より、顔を見て短く話してもらう方が助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大声より短い対面説明がよいと補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ipapakita ko ang numero para magtiyak. Mas nakatutulong ang maikling pagsasalitang nakaharap kaysa malakas na boses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Idagdag na mas mabuti ang maikli at harapang paliwanag kaysa sigaw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望も記録します。診療科の担当にも引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itatala rin ang kahilingang iyon at ipapasa sa kawani ng departamento.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。聞き取れないまま返事をせず、分からない時は聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 理解できない時は聞き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Hindi ako sasagot nang hindi narinig; magtatanong muli kapag hindi naunawaan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing magtatanong muli kung hindi nauunawaan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。呼出しの際はこちらからも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Titiyakin din namin sa inyo kapag tatawagin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 携帯電話をお持ちですね。拾われたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: May dala kayong cellphone. Napulot ba ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。バスの席にありました。運転手さんへ話しましたが、現物は渡していませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: バスで拾い運転手へ知らせたが未引渡しだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Nasa upuan ng bus. Sinabi ko sa driver pero hindi naibigay ang mismong telepono.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na napulot sa bus at sinabi sa driver pero hindi naiabot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 伝えた後、携帯はどこにありましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 落とさないよう私のかばんに入れました。そのまま降りてしまい、今気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: かばんに入れたまま降りた経緯を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Inilagay sa bag para hindi malaglag. Nakababa akong naroon pa rin, ngayon ko lang napansin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang pagbaba nang nasa bag pa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: バス会社へ引き渡した状態ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hindi pa pala naiabot sa kumpanya ng bus.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。届けたつもりと言いそうでしたが、渡したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届けたつもりと実物の引渡しを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Oo. Muntik kong sabihing akala ko naireport na, pero hindi naman naiabot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang pag-aakalang naireport at aktuwal na pag-abot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗った便や、運転手へ話した時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Alam ba ang biyahe at oras nang kausapin ang driver?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この乗車履歴があります。終点の一つ前で話しました。電話の中身は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 便の記録と話した時点を示し中身は未閲覧と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: May travel record na ito. Nagsabi ako sa hintuan bago ang terminal. Hindi ko tiningnan ang laman ng telepono.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang biyahe at oras ng pagsabi at sabihing hindi tiningnan ang laman. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経過と現物を確認します。バス会社への連絡についても担当にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Titiyakin ang pangyayari at ang bagay. Ikonsulta rin sa kawani ang pagkontak sa bus company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現物をこちらに渡します。会社には、口頭で知らせただけで持ち帰っていたと説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現物を渡しバス会社にも経緯を訂正して説明すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Iaabot ko rito ang telepono. Gusto kong ipaliwanag sa kumpanya na nagsabi lang nang pasalita at naiuwi ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iabot ang bagay at sabihing itatama ang paliwanag sa bus company. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。実際の引渡しがどこで行われたか、分かるように記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Itatala nang malinaw kung saan aktuwal na naiabot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Konsultasyon sa koreo matapos lumipat, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。転居届を出したので、会社にも新しい住所が伝わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社登録まで変わるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Nagpasa na ng abiso ng paglipat, malalaman din ba ng kumpanya ang bagong address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung nababago rin ang rehistro sa kumpanya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 郵便の転送手続きで、会社の登録住所が変わるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi binabago ng mail forwarding ang address sa rehistro ng kumpanya.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社への住所変更は自分で連絡するんですね。保険の会社も同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 差出人別の届出が必要と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ako mismo ang mag-aabiso sa kumpanya. Pati insurance company ganito rin?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyaking kailangang hiwalay na abisuhan ang bawat sender. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの差出人へご連絡ください。転送の案内とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kontakin ang bawat nagpapadala. Hiwalay iyon sa gabay ng forwarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では連絡する相手の一覧を作ります。転送されて来た封筒でも、宛先は古いままなんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転送封筒の住所表示を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Gagawa ako ng listahan ng kokontakin. Kahit forwarded ang sobre, luma pa rin ang address na nakasulat?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang address sa forwarded na sobre. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 差出人が旧住所で出した物なら、その記載は残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kung lumang address ang ginamit ng sender, nananatili ang nakasulat na iyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 届いたから変更済みだと思わず、封筒の住所を見て未連絡の所を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 届いた封筒で未変更先を探すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko iisiping napalitan na dahil dumating. Titingnan ang address ng sobre para mahanap ang hindi ko pa nakontak.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hahanapin sa dumating na sobre ang hindi pa nabago. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 転送期間にも限りがあります。案内をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Limitado rin ang panahon ng forwarding. Dalhin ang gabay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 期間を確認して、会社と保険会社へ今日連絡します。転送だけに頼らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 転送期間内に差出人へ変更を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Titiyakin ang panahon at kokontakin ngayon ang kumpanya at insurance. Hindi lang aasa sa forwarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipaalam ang pagbabago sa sender habang nasa forwarding period. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。新住所の受取環境も整えておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Oo. Ihanda rin ang maayos na pagtanggap ng koreo sa bagong address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどのお手続きについてですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。控えの電話番号が一桁短いです。私が書き忘れたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話番号の桁不足を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Kulang ng isang digit ang phone number sa resibo. Baka nakalimutan kong isulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing kulang ng digit ang numero. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 正しい番号を確認できる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: May dokumentong makapagpapatunay ng tamang numero?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の電話の表示がこれです。末尾の前に七が入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正しい番号の資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ito ang display ng sarili kong telepono. May pito bago ang huling digit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang tamang numero sa sanggunian. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 申請内容と照合します。登録完了前なら訂正を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Itutugma sa aplikasyon. Kung hindi pa tapos ang rehistro, masisiguro ang pagwawasto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: もう登録されていた場合も直せますか。電話がつながらなくなるのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 登録後でも直せるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Maitatama rin kung nakarehistro na? Nag-aalala akong hindi makokonekta ang tawag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maitatama kahit tapos na ang rehistro. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状況に応じて変更手続きをご案内します。まず現時点の登録を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Gagabayan ang pagbabago ayon sa estado. Titingnan muna ang kasalukuyang rehistro.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。番号を全部読み上げるので、直す一桁だけでなく全体を照合したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更箇所だけでなく全桁照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakisuyo. Babasahin ko ang buong numero kaya gusto kong itugma lahat, hindi lang isang digit na itatama.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hilinging itugma ang lahat ng digit at hindi lang binago. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。正しい番号で申請を確認し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Titiyakin muli ang aplikasyon sa tamang numero.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号です。新しい控えを受け取ったら、最初から最後まで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正控えを全体で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ito ang numero. Pagkatanggap ng bagong resibo, susuriin mula umpisa hanggang dulo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Suriin ang buong itinamang resibo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正した控えをお渡しします。内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ibibigay ko ang itinamang resibo. Tingnan ang nilalaman.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ito bang produkto ang hinahanap ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。「要加熱」とありますが、レンジで少し温めれば食べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 要加熱を軽い温めでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. May 'kailangang lutuin', maaari bang kainin kung painitin lang sandali sa microwave?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung sapat ang bahagyang pag-init sa kailangang lutuin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 裏面の調理方法もご覧ください。「フライパンで中心まで加熱」とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Basahin din ang pagluluto sa likod. 'Lutuin sa kawali hanggang gitna' ang nakasulat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 温かくするだけとは違うんですね。家にはレンジしかありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家の調理器具の制約を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Iba pala sa basta mainit lang. Microwave lang ang mayroon sa bahay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang limitasyon ng gamit sa pagluluto sa bahay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品は、表示の方法で調理する物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Niluluto ito ayon sa paraang nasa label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レンジで調理できる別の商品はありますか。帰宅してそのまま食べるつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電子レンジ対応の代替品を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: May ibang produktong maluluto sa microwave? Plano kong kainin agad pag-uwi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Maghanap ng alternatibong para sa microwave. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは電子レンジの加熱時間が書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ito ay may oras ng pag-init sa microwave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ワット数で時間が違いますね。私のは五百ワットなので、その欄を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅のワット数に合う時間を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Iba ayon sa wattage. Limang daang watt ang akin, kaya babasahin ko ang kolum na iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Basahin ang oras na tugma sa wattage ng bahay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋を外すかどうかも表示で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tiyakin din sa label kung aalisin ang supot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらに変えます。指定の容器へ移す説明も読んでから温めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器の指示を確認して商品を変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Lilipat ako rito. Babasahin din ang paglipat sa itinakdang lalagyan bago painitin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang gabay ng lalagyan at palitan ang produkto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。購入後も包装の調理表示を残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Salamat. Itabi rin ang cooking label ng pakete matapos bilhin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子さんとご一緒ですか。今の放送は聞こえましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Kasama ang anak ninyo? Narinig ang anunsiyo ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 途中だけ聞こえました。「広場」とありましたが、遊んでいてよいんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 聞き取れなかった放送内容を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Bahagi lang. May 'plaza', puwede bang magpatuloy sa laro?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang anunsiyong hindi narinig nang malinaw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 雨雲が近づいているので、広場から建物側へ移動する案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Paparating ang ulap ng ulan kaya lumipat mula plaza patungo sa mga gusali.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 子供は奥で遊んでいます。まず呼び戻して、一緒に移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 離れた子供を呼び戻すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Naglalaro ang anak sa looban. Tatawagin ko muna at sabay kaming lilipat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing tatawagin ang anak na malayo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お願いします。別々に動かないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Pakisuyo. Huwag kayong kumilos nang magkahiwalay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 戻って来ました。雨宿りできる所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 合流後に雨宿り場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Bumalik na. Saan puwedeng sumilong sa ulan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang silungan matapos magsama. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理棟の前の屋根へご案内します。こちらの舗装路を通ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Gagabayan sa bubong sa harap ng administration building. Gamitin ang sementadong daang ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 木の下ではなく、屋根まで歩きます。子供の荷物も持てました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 木の下を避け荷物をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa bubong kami pupunta, hindi sa ilalim ng puno. Nadala ko rin ang mga gamit ng anak.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Iwasan ang ilalim ng puno at tipunin ang gamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 濡れる前に移動しましょう。道が滑り始めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Lumipat bago mabasa. Nagsisimula nang dumulas ang daan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 走らず手をつないで向かいます。次の放送もそこで聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手をつないで移動し続報を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Maghahawak-kamay nang hindi tumatakbo. Doon din pakikinggan ang susunod na anunsiyo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Lumipat nang magkahawak-kamay at makinig sa susunod na balita. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。管理棟の前で状況をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11229-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Oo. Ipapaliwanag ang sitwasyon sa harap ng administration building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その箱はお一人で運ばれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Mag-isa ninyong binubuhat ang kahong iyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。重いので、このエスカレーターに置いて運びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重い箱を移動する希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Mabigat kaya gusto kong ipatong sa escalator para madala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang gustong paglipat ng mabigat na kahon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱が安定しないと危険です。エレベーターの経路をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Mapanganib kung hindi matatag ang kahon. Gagabayan sa elevator.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 助かります。階段を通らずホームまで行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 階段を避けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Malaking tulong. Makakarating ba sa platform nang walang hagdan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maiiwasan ang hagdan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この通路から行けますが、途中に狭い扉があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Puwede sa pasilyong ito pero may makitid na pinto sa daan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱の幅が広いです。無理に押し込まず、先に通れるか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 狭い扉を通れるか先に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Malapad ang kahon. Gusto kong tiyakin munang kasya, hindi ipilit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyaking makakadaan muna sa makitid na pinto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 幅を見ますので、通路の脇に置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titingnan ang lapad, maaari bang ilagay sa gilid ng pasilyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここに置きます。箱の上に載せた袋も下ろします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱を脇に置いて上の袋を下ろす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Dito ko ilalagay. Ibababa rin ang bag sa ibabaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ilagay ang kahon sa gilid at ibaba ang bag sa ibabaw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この大きさなら通れます。台車の使用については駅の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kasya ang laki na ito. Tungkol sa cart, tingnan ang gabay ng istasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 台車は使わず、持ち直して運びます。列車一本を見送っても急がないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持ち直し列車に急がず移動する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi gagamit ng cart, aayusin ang hawak at bubuhatin. Hindi magmamadali kahit palampasin ang isang tren.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ayusin ang hawak at lumipat nang hindi nagmamadali sa tren. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。前が見える持ち方で、エレベーターへお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11230-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Oo. Hawakan nang kita ang harap at pumunta sa elevator.
